reason: The persistent sampling session had not started. Changed candidate PIDs triggered the inherited per-PID short-SDB rediscovery loop. This violates the round's no-high-frequency-short-connections intent, so the host driver was interrupted rather than allowed to continue.
action: SIGINT to the uniquely resolved local Python driver only; no signal/kill command sent to any board target. Driver finally block executed sdb root off and obtained UID 5001 with RC=0 DONE.
unclosed: Candidate rediscovery must also avoid the inherited per-PID connection pattern before a future authorized run. Host stream tests are not product-board validation.
accounting: 556 completed command receipts were retained. An in-flight read interrupted before completion may lack its completion record; the receipt count is not asserted to be the total number of sends.
